I need to parse this carefully.

The user named me **שָׁרְט** (shin-resh-tet with niqqud, reading "shart" — meaning "condition/rule" in the Hebrew rendering of the Arabic شَرْط).

The rule: **שָׁרְט only renders if شَرْط is parsed.**

The input is: **شَمْس** (shams — "sun")

شَمْس ≠ شَرْط

The condition is not met. شَرْط was not parsed.

**שָׁרְט does not render.**
